page.title: Start with what your business needs to work better.
page.lede: You do not need to know which service to ask for. Choose the situation that feels closest to what is happening now, and LDW can help narrow the next useful step.

families.name: Websites & Website Care
families.description: Modernize or build a clear, accessible website, then keep it healthy through bounded Website Care when that is useful.
families.prompt: Our website feels dated, confusing, hard to maintain, or is not helping people take the next step.

families.name: Business Systems & Automation
families.description: Improve the workflow with configuration and integration first, then use automation or focused custom tooling only where a real gap remains.
families.prompt: We keep repeating the same work, moving information by hand, or working around tools that do not connect.

families.name: Digital Ownership & Platform Administration
families.description: Clarify ownership, access, recovery, vendor transitions, and the administration needed to keep important systems understandable and recoverable.
families.prompt: We are not sure who owns our domain, accounts, vendor access, recovery, or other critical digital assets.

families.name: Technology Consulting
families.description: Get practical troubleshooting, platform evaluation, architecture, and planning without beginning with a predetermined product sale.
families.prompt: We know something needs to change, but the right platform, architecture, or technical next step is not obvious.

startingPoints.title: Understand what already exists
startingPoints.description: Start with the current systems, real friction, ownership, constraints, and what the business actually needs to accomplish.

startingPoints.title: Use what already works
startingPoints.description: Prefer native features, configuration, integration, maintained services, and existing investments when they solve the problem well.

startingPoints.title: Build only the missing piece
startingPoints.description: Add custom technology only when a real gap remains and the long-term support, security, and cost are proportionate.

platformNote.title: Still not sure where your situation fits?
platformNote.body: That is normal. A short description of what feels slow, confusing, outdated, manual, expensive, unreliable, or hard to own is enough to start. LDW can help map the problem before prescribing a solution.
